products.name: Freepik AI
products.note: Stock image AI generation; commercial licensing; EU-hosted; content moderation

reading.body:
Freepik offers AI-generated stock images under commercial licensing, with infrastructure hosted in the EU and content moderation built into the product.

The EU hosting detail is the most operationally significant fact here. Running generative image workloads inside EU jurisdiction implies compliance with regional data and AI governance requirements, which shapes both where the compute sits and what the power contracts behind it must support. Content moderation adds an additional inference layer on top of generation, meaning the compute demand is not limited to the image model alone.

The data covers one product in one category, Image and Graphic Design, and records no deployment cases, no model architecture, and no figures for generation volume or energy consumption. It does not say which cloud or data center operator provides the EU hosting, so no conclusions about grid exposure or power sourcing are possible from what is given.
